files.caption: The sun peeks through the clouds over the Pacific Ocean during the Beyond the Blue: Hawai‘i Mapping expedition on NOAA Ship Okeanos Explorer. Image courtesy of NOAA Ocean Exploration, 2024 Beyond the Blue.
